identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-H.5] Implement v3 proof, parity, soak, shadow, and install routes

values.task_boundary: Implement only the V3-H.5 proof, shadow, soak, and install route behavior and issue-owned proof.
deliverables: csdlc proof route behavior and tests
csdlc shadow route behavior and tests
csdlc soak route behavior and tests
csdlc install route behavior and tests
Issue-owned validation script and retained evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Proof manifests validate deterministic lanes, durable evidence refs, stale evidence, and missing-manifest failures.
AC-2: Shadow compares bounded v2/v3 observations where parity is claimed and refuses broad unproven equivalence.
AC-3: Soak classifies bounded evidence without hidden state, live provider side effects, or authority claims.
AC-4: Install produces one stable csdlc artifact plan with source provenance, selected binary digest, selector metadata, and #505 cutover gating.
AC-5: Tests cover positive proof, missing manifest, stale evidence, parity mismatch, soak evidence gaps, install provenance mismatch, and fail-closed selector errors.
